source_name: CBCG — Statistički podaci (Statistical Data portal)
why_relevant: Master index of all CBCG official statistics domains (monetary/financial, financial soundness indicators, interest rates, T-bills, capital market, external sector, payment system, real and fiscal sector). Single hub from which every ME banking statistics series is reachable; anchor node for A4.

source_name: CBCG — Statistics (English mirror of statistical data portal)
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the same statistics tree (Monetary and Financial Statistics, Financial Soundness Indicators, Interest Rates, Payment System, etc.). Useful for stable English labels/mapping of Montenegrin table names; underlying data files are typically bilingual.

source_name: CBCG — Monetarna i finansijska statistika (Monetary and Financial Statistics)
why_relevant: Legally mandated compilation of monetary statistics under the Law on Official Statistics, using ECB and IMF methodology. Parent of the MFI and other-financial-institution datasets that carry aggregate bank balance sheet, deposits and loans series — the core banking market statistics for a euroised economy.

source_name: CBCG — Statistika monetarnih finansijskih institucija (MFI statistics, monthly ZIP)
why_relevant: The single most important machine-readable release for A4: a monthly ZIP of MFI (bank) statistics — aggregate balance sheet, deposits and loans by sector/maturity, reported in euro. Highest-resolution primary banking market data for Montenegro.

source_name: CBCG — Indikatori finansijske stabilnosti (Financial Soundness Indicators)
why_relevant: Quarterly IMF-methodology FSIs for the banking sector: capital adequacy, liquidity, profitability, asset quality/NPLs, sectoral and geographic credit distribution, FX exposure, real-estate segments. Built from supervisory returns, so it is a creation-point series unavailable elsewhere.

source_name: CBCG — Kamatne stope (Bank and MFI interest rate statistics)
why_relevant: Weighted average nominal and effective active/passive interest rates of banks by sector, purpose and maturity, for stock and new business, plus a separate microcredit-institution series. Core pricing dimension of the banking market.

source_name: CBCG — Platni promet (Payment system statistics section)
why_relevant: Statistics-section home for realised payment traffic in the CBCG RTGS and DNS systems, updated monthly as ZIP archives, plus a historical archive of national payment traffic indicators up to 31.12.2017 (pre-methodology-break series). Directly relevant to payment statistics.

source_name: CBCG — Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu (quarterly payment services & e-money data)
why_relevant: Highest-value source in the whole cell for card/ATM/POS intelligence: quarterly ZIP datasets on number of users by payment service type, number of payment cards issued in Montenegro, number of card-acceptance devices (ATM/POS/other), payment transactions by service type, card and e-money transactions domestic and abroad, and cash deposit/withdrawal transactions.

source_name: CBCG — Statistika platnog sistema Centralne banke Crne Gore (RTGS/DNS monthly reports)
why_relevant: Monthly narrative + PDF reporting on volume and value of orders in the CBCG RTGS and DNS systems, RTGS/DNS split, daily averages and system availability. Complements the statistics-section ZIPs with operational commentary and a longer archive.

source_name: CBCG — Bilten CBCG (monthly statistical bulletin)
why_relevant: Monthly bilingual (sr/en) bulletin with a statistical annex covering monetary developments, the banking system, balance of payments and payment transactions. Convenient single-document time series and the fastest way to detect definition changes. Note a 2025 break: from mid-2025 the bulletin is numbered rather than month-named and dropped real-sector tables.

source_name: CBCG — Makroekonomski izvještaj CBCG (Macroeconomic Report)
why_relevant: Periodic macro report that contextualises banking-sector aggregates (credit growth, deposits, NPLs, interest rates) and often carries derived tables and charts not present in the raw statistical releases.

source_name: CBCG — Izvještaj o stabilnosti finansijskog sistema (Financial System Stability Report)
why_relevant: Annual/periodic financial stability report — banking sector structure, concentration, asset quality, stress tests, and often payment-system oversight sections. Key narrative and derived-indicator source for market structure.

source_name: CBCG — Makroprudencijalna analiza i politika (Macroprudential Analysis and Policy)
why_relevant: Macroprudential analysis series carrying credit-cycle, household/corporate indebtedness and bank-sector vulnerability indicators; complements FSIs with policy-relevant derived metrics.

source_name: CBCG — Izvještaj o rezultatima ankete o kreditnoj aktivnosti banaka (Bank Lending Survey)
why_relevant: ECB-style bank lending survey for Montenegro — credit standards, demand, and terms by segment. Forward-looking soft data on the banking market that no aggregator republishes.

source_name: CBCG — Kalendar objavljivanja statistike (Statistics Release Calendar)
why_relevant: Advance release calendar for every statistic CBCG is the official producer of. Lets a collector schedule fetches precisely instead of polling, and detect missed or postponed releases (a real risk here — FSI Q1 2026 was postponed).

source_name: CBCG — Nadležnost Centralne banke za statistiku (statistical mandate & methodology)
why_relevant: Defines which statistics CBCG is legally the official producer of under the Law on Official Statistics and which methodologies (ECB/IMF) apply. Essential for boundary-setting between CBCG and MONSTAT series and for interpreting definition changes.

source_name: CBCG — Podzakonski akti: Statistika (reporting decisions and report templates)
why_relevant: The decisions and annexed reporting forms that credit institutions must submit (statistical data, payment traffic reports incl. acceptance-device and card forms, banknote/coin denomination forms). Reading the forms reveals the exact fields CBCG holds — including granular ATM/POS and cash variables that may not all be published — and warns of schema changes before they hit the published series.

source_name: CBCG — Finansijski izvještaji banaka (bank-level financial statements)
source_subtype: supervisory disclosure portal (PDF/ZIP per bank per quarter)
why_relevant: Quarterly and audited annual financial statements per individual bank, archived back to roughly 2011. Enables bank-level market-share, concentration and profitability analysis that aggregate statistics cannot support — the disaggregation layer under the CBCG statistics.

source_name: CBCG — Tarife banaka / pregledi tarifa pružalaca platnih usluga
why_relevant: CBCG-maintained comparative overview of bank payment-service tariffs (account, card, ATM withdrawal, transfer fees). Pricing intelligence for the card/ATM/POS layer, sourced from the regulator rather than from each bank's own site.

source_name: CBCG — Registri: platni sistemi, platne institucije i agenti, institucije elektronskog novca
why_relevant: Official registers of licensed payment systems, payment institutions and their agents. These enumerate the actor universe (who must report the payment/card statistics) and are the canonical snowball list for A4 actor mapping in Montenegro.

source_name: CBCG — Godišnji finansijski iskazi Centralne banke Crne Gore
why_relevant: Audited annual financial statements of the central bank itself. Secondary for market statistics but the authoritative record of CBCG's own balance sheet, currency-in-circulation-related items and payment-system revenue, useful as a cross-check on cash-usage and payment-system throughput narratives.

source_name: CBCG — Mapa sajta (site map)
why_relevant: Full enumeration of the CBCG site tree. The site uses multiple interchangeable path prefixes (/me/, /r/, /c/, /public/, and odd legacy prefixes), so the sitemap is the safest way to enumerate canonical statistics URLs and detect page moves rather than treating a 404 as a dead source.

source_name: CBCG — Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu (quarterly PSP/e-money returns)
source_subtype: central bank statistical dataset (ZIP of data files)
why_relevant: Quarterly ECB-style payments tables collected from all payment service providers and e-money issuers: users per payment service, cards issued in Montenegro, POS/acceptance devices, transactions per service type, card and e-money transactions, cross-border card transactions, transactions by terminal type, and cash deposit/withdrawal transactions. This is the card/ATM/POS and cash-usage backbone of the cell.
